correctness.rationale: PASS: The independent recipient-side Bernoulli dynamics on K_{a,2} has state transition increments Bin(a-i,j/2), Bin(2-j,i/a). The exact triangular first-step recurrence H_i and geometric waiting phase yield both starting-side expectations. I independently implemented the recurrence with fractions.Fraction for every integer a=2..11, finding equality 3 at a=2 and strict T_B<T_A for each a=3..11. The bound T_A>=a^2/(2a-1)+1 versus T_B<=ceil(log_2 a)+3 separates at 12<=a<=16 and all a>=17 (via r>=5 dyadic bound). The coupling T_A<=a^2/(2a-1)+T_B plus lower bound yields T_A-T_B=a/2+O(log a). A finite rational test cannot prove the unbounded inequality; the stated analytic bounds do.
